prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Steel, of the Iron Nation — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: her own room in a house of her element's kingdom, its walls and furniture built from the element's materials and colours, a mirror and a window
Time of day: dawn — the first pale light, cool and quiet, the sky just turning; the first pale light at the window, the room still dim.
Hair: her hair twisted up into a high, loose bun with soft strands falling around her face — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Small moment: a light smudge of flour marks her cheek.
Outfit: a soft body-hugging knit dress — in soft oatmeal; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque; styled with worn slipping down off one shoulder, a relaxed oversized fit and an oversized men's dress shirt thrown on over it, half-buttoned with the sleeves rolled, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: reclining on her back.
SUPPORT: the lounger supports her back and head.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body facing the camera; head facing the camera straight on, both ears about equally visible; camera slightly above, looking down at her; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her; the camera stands outside, looking in at her through a large pane of clear glass — one edge of its frame shows at a side of the image and faint reflections lie on its surface, while she is inside the lit space beyond; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right arm bends behind her head, the hand cradling the back of her head, her elbow raised beside her head — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
PROP: with her own left hand she holds a book closed against her chest; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — dark grey iron with bright steel highlights, orange-brown rust and glowing forge-orange heat, magnetism (iron filings, lodestone), hardness and weight, the smell of a smithy; it is the element of tools, weapons, bridges, machines and blood — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: statuesque, long-legged, with a natural neck length — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.
